threshold_source.selection: Minimum false positives subject to recall >= 0.50 on five-fold training OOF scores; primary mode subsequently selected by the user after reviewing prior test results.

implementation_score_semantics.final_python: Exact brute-force binary64 Euclidean distances; k neighbours ordered by distance then training position; selected zero-distance neighbours exclusively, otherwise inverse-distance weighted class-1 fraction.
implementation_score_semantics.final_cpp: Same intended neighbour/vote rules as final_python; sequential C++ distance reduction can differ from NumPy at floating-point precision.
implementation_score_semantics.final_sklearn: Native scikit-learn brute-force Euclidean KNeighborsClassifier, distance weights, n_jobs=1; native distance arithmetic and boundary-tie selection retained.
implementation_score_semantics.final_weka: Unmodified Weka 3.8.6 IBk native inverse-distance distribution, including finite weighting, smoothing and kth-distance tie inclusion; external frozen threshold applied to class-1 score.

model.score_semantics: inverse Euclidean distance; selected exact-zero neighbours exclusively; Weka native distribution separately identified
model.neighbour_tie_rule: distance then original training index for custom implementations

provenance.selection: training-only OOF selection; primary operating mode chosen by user after previous test inspection
provenance.limitation: Fixed-data software reproduction, not a new independent ML validation.
